title: Phase Runner
description: Race down a neon city street that exists in two realities. Swap between DAY and NIGHT to slip through obstacles that only exist in one world, dodge lanes, and chain phase-swap coin streaks as the speed climbs.
instructions: Tap anywhere (or Space / Up) to phase-swap between day and night. Swipe left/right (or Left/Right, A/D) to change lane. Solid objects are in your world; dashed ghosts are in the other. Coins collected right after a swap are worth more. M mutes.
